stages.title: Collection
stages.description: Used paper is collected from homes and businesses in recycling bins and transported by trucks to a recycling centre.

stages.title: Sorting
stages.description: Paper is sorted by type (newspaper, cardboard, office paper) and non-paper items such as plastic and staples are removed.

stages.title: Pulping
stages.description: Sorted paper is shredded and mixed with water and chemicals in large tanks to create a wet mixture called pulp.

stages.title: Cleaning & Screening
stages.description: The pulp is filtered through fine screens to remove glue, staples, and other contaminants.

stages.title: De-Inking
stages.description: Air bubbles are injected into the pulp. Ink particles rise to the surface on the bubbles and are skimmed off.

stages.title: Bleaching
stages.description: (Optional) The pulp is bleached with hydrogen peroxide to produce bright white paper.

stages.title: Sheet Formation
stages.description: Clean pulp is spread onto a moving mesh screen where water drains away and fibres bond together to form a paper sheet.

stages.title: Drying & Rolling
stages.description: The sheet passes through heated rollers to remove remaining moisture and is wound into large rolls.

stages.title: Distribution
stages.description: Finished recycled paper rolls are cut to size and shipped to manufacturers of paper products.

process.title: Життєвий цикл лосося
process.instruction: На діаграмі нижче показано повний життєвий цикл лосося від яйця до дорослої особини. Узагальніть інформацію, вибравши та повідомивши основні характеристики, і зробіть порівняння, де це необхідно. Напишіть не менше 150 слів.

stages.title: Spawning
stages.description: Adult salmon migrate upstream from the ocean to freshwater rivers. Females lay eggs in gravel beds; males fertilise them. Most adults die after spawning.

stages.title: Egg Incubation
stages.description: Fertilised eggs develop inside the gravel for 6–12 weeks, depending on water temperature.

stages.title: Alevin
stages.description: Eggs hatch into tiny fish called alevin, which remain in the gravel and absorb nutrients from an attached yolk sac.

stages.title: Fry
stages.description: Once the yolk sac is absorbed, the young fish (fry) emerge from the gravel and begin feeding on insects and plankton in the stream.

stages.title: Parr
stages.description: Over 1–3 years, fry grow into parr and develop dark markings (parr marks) that camouflage them in the river.

stages.title: Smolt
stages.description: Parr undergo physiological changes (smoltification) to adapt to saltwater and migrate downstream toward the ocean.

stages.title: Adult Ocean Phase
stages.description: Salmon spend 1–4 years at sea, growing rapidly by feeding on fish and crustaceans. They may travel thousands of kilometres.

stages.title: Return Migration
stages.description: Mature adults use their sense of smell to navigate back to their birth river to spawn, completing the life cycle.

process.title: Як сонячні панелі виробляють і розподіляють електроенергію
process.instruction: На діаграмі нижче показано процес, за допомогою якого сонячні батареї генерують електроенергію та розподіляють її в будинках і національній мережі. Узагальніть інформацію, вибравши та повідомивши основні характеристики, і зробіть порівняння, де це необхідно. Напишіть не менше 150 слів.

stages.title: Sunlight Absorption
stages.description: Sunlight strikes the surface of photovoltaic (PV) cells embedded in the solar panel.

stages.title: DC Electricity Generated
stages.description: PV cells convert light energy into direct current (DC) electricity. Cells are connected in series to build up voltage.

stages.title: Inverter Conversion
stages.description: DC electricity flows into an inverter, which converts it into alternating current (AC) electricity compatible with home appliances.

stages.title: Distribution Board
stages.description: AC electricity passes through the home's fuse box and is directed to lights, sockets, and appliances throughout the building.

stages.title: Battery Storage
stages.description: (Optional) Surplus electricity is stored in batteries for use at night or during cloudy periods.

stages.title: Export to Grid
stages.description: Any remaining surplus is fed back into the national grid via a bidirectional smart meter, and homeowners may receive income through feed-in tariffs.

stages.title: Metering & Billing
stages.description: The smart meter records both electricity consumed from the grid and electricity exported, enabling accurate billing and earnings.

stages.title: Collection
stages.description: Used paper is collected from homes and businesses in recycling bins and transported by trucks to a recycling centre.

stages.title: Sorting
stages.description: Paper is sorted by type (newspaper, cardboard, office paper) and non-paper items such as plastic and staples are removed.

stages.title: Pulping
stages.description: Sorted paper is shredded and mixed with water and chemicals in large tanks to create a wet mixture called pulp.

stages.title: Cleaning & Screening
stages.description: The pulp is filtered through fine screens to remove glue, staples, and other contaminants.

stages.title: De-Inking
stages.description: Air bubbles are injected into the pulp. Ink particles rise to the surface on the bubbles and are skimmed off.

stages.title: Bleaching
stages.description: (Optional) The pulp is bleached with hydrogen peroxide to produce bright white paper.

stages.title: Sheet Formation
stages.description: Clean pulp is spread onto a moving mesh screen where water drains away and fibres bond together to form a paper sheet.

stages.title: Drying & Rolling
stages.description: The sheet passes through heated rollers to remove remaining moisture and is wound into large rolls.

stages.title: Distribution
stages.description: Finished recycled paper rolls are cut to size and shipped to manufacturers of paper products.

prompts.instruction: На діаграмі нижче показано повний життєвий цикл лосося від яйця до дорослої особини. Узагальніть інформацію, вибравши та повідомивши основні характеристики, і зробіть порівняння, де це необхідно. Напишіть не менше 150 слів.

stages.title: Spawning
stages.description: Adult salmon migrate upstream from the ocean to freshwater rivers. Females lay eggs in gravel beds; males fertilise them. Most adults die after spawning.

stages.title: Egg Incubation
stages.description: Fertilised eggs develop inside the gravel for 6–12 weeks, depending on water temperature.

stages.title: Alevin
stages.description: Eggs hatch into tiny fish called alevin, which remain in the gravel and absorb nutrients from an attached yolk sac.

stages.title: Fry
stages.description: Once the yolk sac is absorbed, the young fish (fry) emerge from the gravel and begin feeding on insects and plankton in the stream.

stages.title: Parr
stages.description: Over 1–3 years, fry grow into parr and develop dark markings (parr marks) that camouflage them in the river.

stages.title: Smolt
stages.description: Parr undergo physiological changes (smoltification) to adapt to saltwater and migrate downstream toward the ocean.

stages.title: Adult Ocean Phase
stages.description: Salmon spend 1–4 years at sea, growing rapidly by feeding on fish and crustaceans. They may travel thousands of kilometres.

stages.title: Return Migration
stages.description: Mature adults use their sense of smell to navigate back to their birth river to spawn, completing the life cycle.

prompts.title: Як сонячні панелі виробляють і розподіляють електроенергію
prompts.instruction: На діаграмі нижче показано процес, за допомогою якого сонячні батареї генерують електроенергію та розподіляють її в будинках і національній мережі. Узагальніть інформацію, вибравши та повідомивши основні характеристики, і зробіть порівняння, де це необхідно. Напишіть не менше 150 слів.

stages.title: Sunlight Absorption
stages.description: Sunlight strikes the surface of photovoltaic (PV) cells embedded in the solar panel.

stages.title: DC Electricity Generated
stages.description: PV cells convert light energy into direct current (DC) electricity. Cells are connected in series to build up voltage.

stages.title: Inverter Conversion
stages.description: DC electricity flows into an inverter, which converts it into alternating current (AC) electricity compatible with home appliances.

stages.title: Distribution Board
stages.description: AC electricity passes through the home's fuse box and is directed to lights, sockets, and appliances throughout the building.

stages.title: Battery Storage
stages.description: (Optional) Surplus electricity is stored in batteries for use at night or during cloudy periods.

stages.title: Export to Grid
stages.description: Any remaining surplus is fed back into the national grid via a bidirectional smart meter, and homeowners may receive income through feed-in tariffs.

stages.title: Metering & Billing
stages.description: The smart meter records both electricity consumed from the grid and electricity exported, enabling accurate billing and earnings.
